label: SCOUTING, placeholder costs, train years 2017-2022, reference engine; claims no return edge

readings.alarm_limits: 'more than 10 of 100' and 'more than 30 of 400' as more than n // 10 and more than 3 n // 10 (80 panels: 8 and 24)
readings.boundary: V-bar is the mean (math.fsum) of the other panels' finite V at that w; a panel with a MISSING V is not tested; each tail's count is pooled over the four w
readings.copies: The guarded copies' and their mixes' runs are measured by DD only (no fee check): A0 is a check of the statistics, not of the accounting, which run 0 checks on every run
readings.exit: An alarm prints ALARM and exits 3 after writing a0.json; no alarm exits 0. The last line names the alarms ('A0 alarms: A0-<n>, ...') or prints run.py's pinned phrase 'A0 alarms: none' (stop rule 8's record)
readings.fallback: 100 panels a set when the projection at 100 is at most 600 CPU-minutes (the owner's limit, raised from 300 by amendment M2); else 80 when the projection at 80 is; else refused (stop rule 7)
readings.nc_windows: On NC the q of each window (its switch-on decision included) is computed on the schedule panel and run on the price panel's window
readings.resampling_seed: Each panel's RISK-X uses run 0's procedure, one index set from default_rng(0) (section 9.2) over the 2189 return rows of the train grid, shared by every panel; the disjointness of section 13 is the panels' market streams'
